subject: English
question_text: Fill in the gaps with suitable prepositions, articles and zero articles (a, an, the or x): 0.
stimulus: Bangladesh is a free land but she is beset (a)____ many problems. The use of poly bags is very dreadful. Recently it has become (b) ____ great threat (c) our environment. (d) ____ used poly bags block the drainage system. As a result, the low-lying areas (e) ____ the towns and the cities go under (f) ____ dirty water when it rains heavily. The used poly bags also destroy (g) ____ fertility of our soil. Our government has already banned the production (h) ____ poly bags. Yet some greedy and (i) ____ dishonest businessmen are producing the bags (j) ____ their own interest.
guide_solution: (a) with (b) a (c) to (d) the (e) of (f) the (g) the (h) of (i) × (j) for
source: SSC English 2nd-paper Dinajpur Board-2022 (Board Question With Solution)
